metadata.client: Geologix Vanguard — Cross-Portfolio Tender Monitoring System
metadata.scope: South Africa national tender portals, mining house procurement portals, municipal tender sources, aggregators, and data format assessment

national_portals.name: National Treasury eTenders Portal
national_portals.update_frequency: Real-time as tenders are captured; award decisions must appear within 7 days of decision; daily new listings
national_portals.registration_requirements: All suppliers must first register on the Central Supplier Database (CSD) at https://secure.csd.gov.za — requires CIPC registration, valid tax clearance, SARS compliance, and BBBEE status. CSD registration is the single gateway for all government procurement participation.

data_format.api_spec: OCDS-compliant JSON REST API (Open Contracting Data Standard); OpenAPI spec available
data_format.notes: Best API coverage of any SA tender source. Transparency portal is in public beta. PowerBI / Tableau / QlikView connectors documented.

national_portals.portal_note: This is the master source that most aggregators pull from. Integrating directly with the OCDS API gives Geologix Vanguard the cleanest, most comprehensive feed.

national_portals.name: CIDB — Construction Industry Development Board
national_portals.update_frequency: Variable; i-Tender email and SMS alerts sent immediately on new relevant postings for registered contractors
national_portals.registration_requirements: CIDB contractor grading registration (Grades 1–9); grade is based on financial capability (annual turnover) and works capability (class of works: CE for Civil Engineering, GB for General Building, SH for Specialist Works, etc.). Grade 1 allows contracts up to ~R200k; Grade 9 is unlimited. All public sector construction contracts above R200k require CIDB-registered contractors.

grading_classes_relevant_to_veralogix.CE: Civil Engineering — relevant for Veralogix Construction / plant infrastructure
grading_classes_relevant_to_veralogix.EB: Electrical — relevant for Veralogix Energy (solar installations)
grading_classes_relevant_to_veralogix.ME: Mechanical Engineering — relevant for plant and processing equipment work
grading_classes_relevant_to_veralogix.SH: Specialist Works — including security and other specialised services

data_format.notes: No public API. i-Tender alert system requires CIDB registration but is free. Web portal is HTML-only.

national_portals.name: Eskom Supplier and Tender Portal
national_portals.update_frequency: Daily (tender bulletin); new tenders posted as issued
national_portals.registration_requirements: Step 1: Register on National Treasury CSD (secure.csd.gov.za). Step 2: Complete Eskom Supplier Database registration (online form). Requirements: legally registered SA entity, valid tax clearance, B-BBEE status level certificate, financial stability proof. Annual procurement exceeds R80 billion.
key_procurement_categories: Plant and station maintenance (Veralogix Plant / Construction)

data_format.notes: No public API or RSS. Tender Bulletin is HTML-based. Tenders also appear on etenders.gov.za (captured via OCDS API). High-value portal for Veralogix Group.

national_portals.registration_requirements: Step 1: CSD registration (secure.csd.gov.za). Step 2: Transnet Vendor Registration via eSupplier portal. Covers: Transnet SOC Ltd, Transnet Freight Rail, Transnet Port Terminals, Transnet Engineering, Transnet Pipelines, Transnet Properties.

Security services at freight depots and ports (Veralogix Security)

data_format.notes: Transnet tenders also appear on etenders.gov.za. eSupplier portal requires login for full access. No public API.

national_portals.name: Armscor — Armaments Corporation of South Africa
national_portals.registration_requirements: Armscor Supplier & Security Registration — requires security vetting for defence-classified contracts. Once registered, profile visible to all Armscor entities. Standard CSD registration also required.
national_portals.relevance_assessment: Limited direct relevance to core Veralogix Group operations. Potentially relevant to Veralogix Security (physical security at SANDF facilities or defence logistics sites) and Veramani IT (defence IT infrastructure). Procurement is defence-acquisition dominated; industrial/civil opportunities do arise for facilities maintenance and security guarding at defence installations.

data_format.notes: Tenders also aggregated by TenderBulletins.co.za and TenderAlerts.co.za.

data_format_assessment.summary: The National Treasury eTenders OCDS API is the single most important integration point for Geologix Vanguard's tender database. It is the only SA source with a true public REST API and bulk download capability. All other portals are HTML/PDF scrape-only or require supplier login credentials.
data_format_assessment.recommendation_for_geologix_database: Implement a two-track data collection strategy: (1) Primary — pull daily from the National Treasury OCDS JSON API (data.etenders.gov.za), which captures all government departments, SOEs, and many municipalities automatically. (2) Secondary — scheduled scraping of entity-specific portals not covered by eTenders: Eskom Tender Bulletin, Transnet eSupplier, CIDB i-Tender, Armscor, and mining house portals. Mining house portals require supplier login (SAP Ariba / Coupa) — these cannot be scraped; instead, assign a dedicated procurement relationship manager to monitor each portal manually.
